calibration: Default parameters are illustrative and not fitted to matched cancer-cell experiments.
validation: Cancer-outcome hypotheses are unvalidated. Numerical checks do not establish biological validity.
literature: Search results awaiting relevance screening. Not exhaustive or a completed systematic review.
assumptions: Fixed ionic conductances and reversal potentials
Charge compensation represented by eta, without explicit proton-channel kinetics
No fitted mapping to ROS, proliferation, apoptosis or treatment efficacy
Calcium driving force is not calcium concentration
Injected current is not an applied electric field

changeLog.change: Added explicit exploratory status, documentation links and export labels. Model equations and defaults unchanged.
